prompt: Refresh the accepted cybersecurity-continuity relationship for CrowdStrike against material fiscal-Q2 2027 evidence.

payload.objective: Review exactly one accepted idea-security edge using fiscal-Q2 evidence; update its mechanism, direction, sensitivity, confidence, catalyst, invalidation and review state without changing the idea or security assessment.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Persistent continuity, endpoint, identity, cloud and managed-security demand supports CrowdStrike ARR and module consolidation; Q2 net-new ARR, Falcon Flex and module adoption strengthened the transmission, while pricing, retention, trust, acquisition and dilution constrain per-share realization.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Invalidate if retention or module adoption weakens, bundling compresses pricing, trust failures impair renewals, competition slows platform consolidation, or rising equity and acquisition costs prevent growth from converting into per-share cash value.
inputs.evidence_reason: Fiscal-Q2 2027 is material new primary evidence after the relationship's prior review and directly updates both the catalyst and limiting risks.
